title: buildzr level graphs (buildzr.levels/2): the W1 -> W2 hand-over
description: Output of buildzr/site/levels.py, input of buildzr/site/layout/. One level per scene to lay out: 'landscape', 'e/<path>' for every element with children, 'v/<key>' for every authored view. Everything a scene needs except geometry: nodes with resolved style, shape and UNWRAPPED label lines; rolled-up edges with rels; ports (by id and direction, no position). Sorting and ids are exactly those of the scene (scene.schema.json), so layout only adds x/y/w/h, points, bounds and port positions, and wraps label text.

levels.description: Parents before children: landscape, then e/<path> in model pre-order, then v/<key> in view order.

branding.description: Only when the workspace has images (icons, logo) or a branding font: the content of data/branding.<h8>.json without its 'schema'.

diagnostics.description: What of the themes, images and branding font is not used, and why (build.json 'warnings').

incomplete.description: A theme icon could not be fetched (no network, a timeout, an upstream error), so the built workspace lacks it (build.json 'incomplete').

ports.description: Element levels only: one per parent-level edge touching the scope, id = that edge's id, sorted by id.

dir.description: in: the parent edge targets the scope (child edges start at the port); out: the reverse.

nodes.description: Pre-order, siblings sorted by id (as in the scene).

style.description: Resolved node style, exactly the scene node 'style' object.

lines.description: Unwrapped label lines; layout wraps each line's text to the box width and keeps tier/weight/size/italic on every wrapped piece.

children.description: Present iff the element has children at the next level (becomes frame.children; frame.scene = 'e/<id>').

instances.description: Deployment nodes whose instance count is not '1' (the scene node's 'instances').

edges.description: Sorted by id. source/target are node ids or {"port": id}.

style.description: Resolved edge style, exactly the scene edge 'style' object.

lines.description: Unwrapped edge label lines (may be empty: no label).
